It has a huge mountain back drop skyline that dwarfs Philly's smaller foothill skyline. As for mass rail transit Chicago ranks 2nd in the nation to NYC with a larger network consisting of CTA and Metra systems which covers a larger area than Septa. Chicago also has 2 baseball teams and the nation's largest pier Navy Pier. However, Philly is an older city from the colonial period but Chicago was the birth place of the skyscraper and has more 19th century buildings.
